answer: Ask what breaks first and it is replication cost. Every answer must be verifiable from a stored commitment, so one upheld challenge revokes that identity's whole epoch, and keeping a copy alive is priced above the honest path by construction. On a tundra of cheap VPS nodes the cipher work is not the expense, standing renewal is. That is the line a farm cannot cross: replication at scale costs more than the terrace of real answers it replaces.
